title: Arbitrary-arrow scalar adjunct from normalized natural units
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C,\mathcal J$ be abelian categories with small Ext [def-pc-ext], and choose derived categories of $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal J$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $T:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal J)$ be a functor. Let $E:\mathcal J\to\mathcal B$, $U:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal B$ and $V:\mathcal C\to\mathcal A$ be additive exact functors, and supply $\sigma:V\simeq F\circ U$ (composition is read in diagrammatic order). Supply a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to T\circ D(E\circ U)$. Let $S,M\in\mathcal A$, $X,H\in\mathcal J$ and $Q,P\in\mathcal C$, with $a:T(S[0])\simeq X[0]$, $b:T(M[1])\simeq H[2]$, $s:E(X)\simeq F(Q)$, $t:E(H)\simeq F(P)$, $q:S\to U(E(X))$, $g:S\to V(Q)$ and $\kappa\in\mathrm{Ext}^1(M,V(P))$. Assume the unit followed by $D(EU)(a)$ and its single comparison equals $q[0]$. Assume the unit at $M[1]$ followed by $D(EU)(b)$, its shift and single comparisons, and $(U(t)\sigma_P^{-1})[2]$, equals $-\kappa[1]$ followed by inverse shift addition. Assume $q;U(s);\sigma_Q^{-1}=g$. For $f\in\mathrm{Ext}^1(S,M)$ and $e\in\mathrm{Ext}^2(Q,P)$, if $F(e)$ equals evaluation by $E$ of $a^{-1}T(f)b$ transported by $s^{-1}$ and $t$, then $g;V(e)=-f\kappa$. No assumption that F is full on Ext is made.

source.place: Step (4): arbitrary-arrow naturality, separated from construction of the normalized target.

proof.text: Under Ext.homEquiv, precomposition by the source quotient unit cancels the single-object comparison. Functoriality cancels the mapped a.hom and a.inv. Naturality of eta on f.hom and the negative target normalization give the negative shifted composite representing the Yoneda product.

Apply exact U to the supplied residue-lift equation. The proved exact-functor composition comparison identifies iterated maps and the comparison sigma. Precompose by g, whose normalization cancels sigma with its inverse and s with its inverse. Associativity combines the remaining target maps with t and sigma inverse. Insert the Ext identity from the preceding step.

proof_origin.place: Step (4), expanded as naturality and exact Ext functoriality.

theorem kummer_adjunct_from_unit
    {A B C J : Type*}
    [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasExt.{w} A]
    [Category B] [Abelian B] [HasExt.{w} B]
    [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasExt.{w} C]
    [Category J] [Abelian J] [HasExt.{w} J]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} J]
    (T : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory J)
    (E : J ⥤ B) [E.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits E] [PreservesFiniteColimits E]
    (U : B ⥤ A) [U.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    (F : C ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (V : C ⥤ A) [V.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (σ : V ≅ F ⋙ U)
    (η : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory A) ⟶ T ⋙ (E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategory)
    {S M : A} {X H : J} {Q P : C}
    (a : T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj S) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor J 0).obj X)
    (b : T.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor J 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (s : E.obj X ≅ F.obj Q) (t : E.obj H ≅ F.obj P)
    (q : S ⟶ U.obj (E.obj X)) (g : S ⟶ V.obj Q) (κ : Ext M (V.obj P) 1)
    (hq : η.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj S) ≫
      (E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategory.map a.hom ≫
      ((E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app X =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).map q)
    (hκ : η.app (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
      (E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategory.map b.hom ≫
      ((E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (2 : ℤ)).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor J 0).obj H) ≫
      (((E ⋙ U).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).map (U.map t.hom ≫ σ.inv.app P))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' =
      -(κ.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorAdd (DerivedCategory A) (1 : ℤ) 1).inv.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj (V.obj P))))
    (hg : q ≫ U.map s.hom ≫ σ.inv.app Q = g)
    (f : Ext S M 1) (e : Ext Q P 2)
    (he : e.mapExactFunctor F = (Ext.mk₀ s.inv).comp
      (((Ext.homEquiv.symm (a.inv ≫ T.map f.hom ≫ b.hom)).mapExactFunctor E).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ t.hom) (add_zero 2)) (zero_add 2)) :
    (Ext.mk₀ g).comp (e.mapExactFunctor V) (zero_add 2) = -(f.comp κ rfl)
